appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Renewable Energy Production by Source'.
Y-axis has tick marks from 0 to 70 in increments of 5.
Bar for 'Wind' is light blue, labeled '29.8%'.

printed_facts.fact: The bar heights correspond to the percentages: Solar (41.2%), Wind (29.8%), Hydroelectric (18.5%), Biomass (7.2%), Geothermal (3.3%).

public_definitions: The goal is to identify the largest renewable generation contribution source from the dashboard and route that source record to escalated contribution review.
The chart shows 'Renewable Energy Production by Source' with 'Reported production share (%)' on the Y-axis.
The options for routing are: 'Escalate Solar to contribution review', 'Escalate Wind to contribution review', 'Keep Hydroelectric in routine source monitoring'.
